proposals.before: When the Prince of Jin campaigned against Wang Xingyu, Chengye shuttled among the armies; Li Keyong took a liking to him.
proposals.after: When the Prince of Jin campaigned against Wang Xingyu, Chengye shuttled among the armies; the Prince of Jin took a liking to him.
proposals.reason: Chinese has only 晉王 twice; idiomatic invents the personal name Li Keyong for the second reference.

proposals.before: Zhuangzong held a banquet in the vault. Wine deep, he made his son Jiji dance for Chengye; when the boy finished, Chengye offered a jeweled belt, silks, and a horse. Zhuangzong pointed at the coin stacks and called to Chengye by Jiji’s pet name: “Hege needs money—give him that whole pile. Why offer belt and horse?”
proposals.after: Zhuangzong held a banquet in the vault. Wine deep, he made his son Jiji dance for Chengye; when the boy finished, Chengye offered a jeweled belt, silks, and a horse. Zhuangzong pointed at the coin stacks and, calling Jiji by his pet name, said to Chengye: “Hege needs money—give him that whole pile. Why offer belt and horse?”
proposals.reason: Chinese 呼繼岌小字以語承業 means he addressed Chengye while using Jiji’s pet name, not that he called Chengye by that name.

proposals.before: Later, when Emperor Min fled to Weizhou, Hanqiong went west to meet the deposed emperor on the road; the deposed emperor despised him and had him killed.
proposals.after: Later, when Emperor Min fled to Weizhou, Hanqiong went west to meet the deposed emperor on the road; the deposed emperor hated him and had him killed.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic “despised” softens 惡; literal “hated” better matches the lethal outcome.

decisions.reason: Focus unit repeats 晉王 for both the campaign and 喜其為人; the idiomatic second clause invents the personal name Li Keyong, which is not in the Chinese. Restoring “the Prince of Jin” matches the source.

呼繼岌小字以語承業曰 means Zhuangzong used Jiji’s childhood name while speaking to Chengye; the before wording wrongly makes Chengye the one addressed by that pet name. The proposed fix restores the attribution.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呼繼岌小字以語承業曰

decisions.reason: 廢帝惡而殺之 is already rendered accurately enough as “despised…and had him killed”; swapping despised for hated is stylistic preference, not a semantic correction.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0001 shows the personal name Li Keyong was invented by the bad idiomatic; s0008 only names 晉王, already claimed in c0018.
